title: The Silent Man's Fall
narrative: Unable to bear the accusation and disgrace, Banquo takes his own life. Macbeth uses the chaos to claim the crown. Macduff urges Malcolm to resist, but their rising ends in defeat.
truth_reveal: Banquo knew the witches' complete prophecy.
By detaining a servant near midnight, Banquo cleared Macbeth's route to Duncan's chamber.
Banquo heard signs of danger but remained behind his locked door and did not stop the murder.

character_fates.banquo: Accused of the murder, Banquo dies by suicide.
character_fates.lady_macbeth: Lady Macbeth retains power at court.
character_fates.malcolm: Malcolm loses his opportunity to reclaim the crown.

title: The Bloodstained Crown
narrative: Macduff exposes Macbeth's ambition and the truth of Duncan's murder. He rallies Malcolm's cause and kills Macbeth. Lady Macbeth takes her own life after her mind collapses beneath the weight of guilt, and Malcolm becomes king.
truth_reveal: Duncan's secret order gave Macbeth an urgent motive: he was about to lose his military command.
Macbeth entered Duncan's chamber and stabbed him with a dagger.
Lady Macbeth drugged the guards, gave the signal, and staged the scene to blame them.
Banquo knew enough to suspect the plan but chose silence.

character_fates.banquo: Banquo survives but must answer for his silence.
character_fates.lady_macbeth: Lady Macbeth dies by suicide after a mental collapse.
character_fates.macduff: Macduff becomes the central figure in exposing and avenging the murder.

title: The Hand Behind the Crown
narrative: The accusation identifies Lady Macbeth as the architect of the regicide. The full truth reveals the shared guilt of Macbeth and his wife. Macduff kills Macbeth, Lady Macbeth dies after her mind breaks under guilt, and Malcolm inherits the crown.
truth_reveal: Lady Macbeth obtained poppy extract under the pretense that it was a sleeping draught.
She mixed the drug into the guards' wine.
She returned the daggers to the guards' hands and smeared Duncan's blood over them.
Blood remained on the cuffs of her formal gown despite repeated washing.

character_fates.banquo: Banquo survives but carries the burden of having remained silent.
character_fates.lady_macbeth: Lady Macbeth dies by suicide after her guilt is exposed.
character_fates.macduff: Macduff helps Malcolm restore order to Scotland.

title: A Kingdom Consumed by Old Grievances
narrative: Macduff's family grievance is mistaken for the strongest motive. Malcolm flees to England, Macbeth claims the crown, and Lady Macbeth rules beside him. Macduff's household is destroyed, and Banquo is later murdered.
truth_reveal: Macduff did form a secret alliance with Malcolm, but he did not kill Duncan.
Mary was Macduff's informant inside Lady Macbeth's household.
Macduff arranged for a Fife family ring to be planted in the guard's baggage as a political maneuver.

character_fates.banquo: Banquo is assassinated by Macbeth's agents.
character_fates.lady_macbeth: Lady Macbeth becomes queen and regent.
character_fates.macduff: Macduff is falsely condemned, and his household is slaughtered.
character_fates.malcolm: Malcolm lives in exile in England.

title: The Disinherited Prince
narrative: Malcolm's conflict with his father and the evidence implicating his guard convince the court that he committed parricide. Macbeth takes the crown, Malcolm is executed, Macduff's household is destroyed, and Banquo is assassinated.
truth_reveal: Malcolm did quarrel with Duncan, but he was preparing support in England rather than planning murder.
Lady Macbeth used Malcolm's personal guard as part of the staged scene.
Malcolm witnessed Mary carrying the drugged wine but lacked enough evidence to stop the crime.

character_fates.banquo: Banquo is assassinated by Macbeth's agents.
character_fates.lady_macbeth: Lady Macbeth becomes queen and regent.
character_fates.malcolm: Malcolm is accused and executed by Macbeth.
